matches.quote: The ±10/±15 meV maps sit inside the ~20 meV gap, and the sign change of P near 10 meV lies within it.
Fig. 3b: indicate where each spectrum was taken.
The FT analysis pipeline may create or exaggerate the x/y anisotropy... show that P is insensitive to window size and placement
show that the contrast is unchanged under reversal of an applied field (a cluster tip with a remanent moment would respond)
so a BiBr tip scanning Fe1.02Te could become a conventional magnetic-cluster tip... state whether any tip used on KV2Se2O had previously been used on Fe1.02Te.
P 'varies among different tips, possibly due to the specific geometry of the tip apex'... predict the sign, size (~±12%) and bias-oddness of P(V)
The √2×√2 density wave is not separated from the surface K reconstruction... band folding and gap in Fig. 4d could be imposed by the surface K potential
what fixes the hinge location relative to the milled apex. A demonstration that the apex hosts a gapless hinge rather than gapped edges would strengthen the claim.
The defects are assigned as V vacancies, so the bound state lives on neighbouring sites... a bound state's field shift reflects the spin of that quasiparticle state
show M(q,eV) and P(E) for the helical-edge-mode tip, the bulk-state BiBr tip and a PtIr tip on the same FOV and domain
measure Bi4Br4-tip QPI on a nonmagnetic but anisotropic reference surface, ideally a C2 quasi-1D system or the 2×1 K surface of KV2Se2O
Orbital-selective tunneling matrix elements of the tip... Its DOS is strongly asymmetric between filled and empty states (Fig. 2b, f), so it can weight q_x and q_y differently
as written, the paper's explanation of the tips that fail implies that the tips that succeed should not see the order either.
The normalization uses Bragg peaks that come from the K reconstruction, whose intensities may be bias dependent and anisotropic.
In Fig. 5, panel l is placed before e.
show a full field sweep (0, ±1, …, ±7 T) establishing linearity, the shift of each peak separately, any hysteresis, and the absence of tip changes
'Topology-guaranteed spin filter', 'decisively rules out', 'unambiguously demonstrate' and 'smoking gun' (p. 7) overstate indirect evidence.
show, by DFT... with the supercell included... and state which bands q_x¹ and q_y¹ connect after folding
The √2×√2 density wave splits each sublattice into inequivalent sites (V_xa/V_xb, V_ya/V_yb)... The paper does not determine the spins of the a/b sites within the supercell.
give the full energy dependence P(V) of the stripe contrast, not only ±50 mV

notes: C15 is graded 'partly' because P14 raises magnetic-atom pickup on Fe1.02Te (and asks if those tips were used on KV2Se2O) rather than V pickup directly. C14 is graded 'partly' because P6 requests full field sweeps tracking each subgap peak separately rather than explicitly accusing the authors of cherry-picking among multiple peaks. C12 is graded 'partly' because P4 notes that the K-reconstruction Bragg peaks used for normalization may be bias-dependent rather than explicitly pointing out their different spot brightness between Fig. 5f and 5h.
